checks.name: four original build examples are normalized isolated drafts with real component masses
normalization rejects inherited types, nonfinite coordinates, invalid bounds and part-budget excess
normalization sanitizes name/color/angle/ids and preserves empty work-in-progress
weighted COM and rotational inertia are calculated from actual component placements
visible mounts and actual wheel contact centers use the same rotated chassis coordinates
moving identical wheels changes actual running and pitch while preserving total mass
fan direction affects applied thrust and resulting travel with identical mass and wheelbase
fan mount height creates a different real moment about the weighted COM
ballast placement changes stability through mass distribution rather than a rating
spring wheels expose longer actual compression travel and a different suspension response
braking acts through real tire contact and slows a moving car
terrain is deterministic, flat at the start and has genuine slopes/ramps/dips
phase-gated actions preserve drafts and prevent mid-race assembly
empty assembly can be edited, cannot be started, and safely falls back at the deadline
fixed stepping gives identical 30 and 120fps simulations with ordinary public input
pause freezes clocks, physical position and event generation and releases throttle
recover uprights at the same position, releases momentum, has cooldown and a disclosed20m penalty
full two-heat run uses exactly178 active seconds and earns a record only at series finish
all controls idle still ends both heats on time without fabricated motion
unfinished reload and cancel preserve earned records and draft, never unfinished points
corrupt saved records fail safely and isolated snapshots cannot mutate active machinery
